deku_animes_luffy_vs_lucci.title: Luffy Gear 5 vs Lucci [AMV] Courtesy Call
key_editing_techniques: Rapid beat-synced cutting (cuts every 1.1s - 1.8s during rock and trap drops)
Directional whip zoom transitions on strike impacts
High contrast grade with saturation boost (+35%) on Conqueror lightning arcs
Bass-drop screen shake and RGB chromatic displacement on heavy hits
Subtle dark vignette to focus audience gaze on character center

darin_joyboy_royalty.title: Joy Boy's return (One Piece) [AMV] Royalty
darin_joyboy_royalty.song: Royalty - Egzod and Maestro Chives ft. Neoni
key_editing_techniques: Manga Ink Bleed: High-contrast black and white monochrome on serious backstory frames
Wide tracking (letter-spacing) on geometric all-caps sans-serif typography (Segoe UI Bold / Montserrat)
Keyword color accents: Blood Crimson for Joy Boy, Electric Cyan for Liberation, Gold for Sun God Nika
Deep sidechain ducking of background music during iconic voice dialogues (Zunesha and Luffy)
Violent trap drop synchronization on the climax combat clash

goku_mui_vs_jiren_4k.title: GOKU MASTERED ULTRA INSTINCT VS FULL POWER JIREN{4K ULTRA HD}
key_editing_techniques: Godly Ultra Instinct silver/blue aura bloom color grading
Negative flash transition on supreme counter impacts
High-speed dual laser tracking during Null Realm debris flight
Heavy orchestral brass drop synchronization on climactic strikes
Anamorphic 2.35:1 letterbox cinematic framing for wide-angle battle staging

directional_whip_pan_blur.title: Directional Whip Pan & Motion Blur Ramping
directional_whip_pan_blur.description: Applies directional vector blur aligned with combat strike angles during exponential speed ramps.
directional_whip_pan_blur.pacing_impact: Accelerates perceived velocity between cuts without causing visual disorientation.

temporal_ghost_trails.title: Temporal Ghost Trailing (Combat Frame Echo)
temporal_ghost_trails.description: Multi-frame opacity decay (100% -> 50% -> 20%) highlighting superhuman dashes and flash steps.
temporal_ghost_trails.pacing_impact: Elevates sense of god-tier speed during close-quarters hand-to-hand combat.
